title: RIS-Kernel: A Model-Agnostic Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference via Sparse Attention
description:
arXiv:2607.21927v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Full self-attention in large language models scales as O(N^2), which limits long-context document analysis to 65,536 tokens and requires costly GPU clusters. The Reduced Interaction Sampling (RIS) inference engine addresses this constraint as a model-agnostic architecture.
